game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Lantern Path, a lantern-lit path: the herbalist must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Iteration Tracer: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops.
theme: Mystic Forest – Lantern Path: a lantern-lit path
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Path, repeat each round: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops. Each round, mischievous sprites strike the mushroom ring, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trace_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the mushroom ring from mischievous sprites in Lantern Path: keep the trace_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: trace_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Iteration Tracer
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Iteration Tracer' (Week 5 slot 12), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Lantern Path'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous sprites in Lantern Path.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 43 seconds while trace_score > 0.
